sentences.en: The balance at the bank stands at two million yen.
sentences.zh: 银行账户上有两百万日元。

sentences.en: The generous dentist contributed some two billion yen to charity.
sentences.zh: 这位慷慨的牙医向慈善机构捐赠了两百亿日元。

sentences.en: Our company has annual sales of a thousand million yen.
sentences.zh: 我们公司的年销售额是一千亿日元。

senses.zh: 日元（日本货币单位）；渴望
